delete.description:
List the location types configured in a project space, or fetch a single location type by identifier. Location types define the organizational hierarchy (for example state, district, or facility) that locations belong to.

Requires the `edit_locations` permission.

administrative.description: Whether this is an administrative location type (a fixed geographic boundary, e.g. state or district) as opposed to an inventory-management type (e.g. facility).

code.description: Slug identifying the location type, used to filter locations and in bulk data imports.

domain.description: Domain (project space) that owns the location type.

parent.description: URI of the parent location type, or null if this is a root-level type.

shares_cases.description: Whether users assigned to a location of this type share cases owned by that location.

view_descendants.description: Whether users assigned to a location of this type can view data belonging to descendant locations.
